# What it takes to build xrdp and xorgxrdp on Fedora.
# One package per line, then why it is needed. build/build-xrdp-pkg.sh
# installs these; ./check-deps.sh shows whether a release has them all.
#
# The packages' own run-time dependencies are not listed here: rpmbuild
# reads them from the built binaries, and check-deps.sh shows them too.

# tools
gcc                     C compiler
make                    builds xrdp, xorgxrdp and x264
autoconf                xrdp and xorgxrdp use autotools
automake                xrdp and xorgxrdp use autotools
libtool                 xrdp and xorgxrdp use autotools
pkgconf-pkg-config      finds the libraries below
nasm                    x264's assembly
cmake                   builds Opus
ninja-build             builds Opus
git                     fetches x264 (no release tarballs)
curl                    downloads the sources
gnupg2                  checks the xrdp and xorgxrdp signatures
xz                      unpacks .tar.xz sources
file                    used by the packaging step
diffutils               used by configure scripts
rpm-build               rpmbuild, makes the packages

# libraries xrdp uses from the distribution
openssl-devel           TLS
pam-devel               logins (PAM)
libX11-devel            xrdp-chansrv: clipboard and the X session
libXfixes-devel         xrdp-chansrv: clipboard
libXrandr-devel         xrdp-chansrv: screen layout
libjpeg-turbo-devel     JPEG codec
fuse3-devel             file copy and drive redirection
pixman-devel            faster screen updates
freetype-devel          fonts on the login screen
imlib2-devel            images on the login screen

# xorgxrdp
xorg-x11-server-devel   the Xorg server xorgxrdp is a driver for
